title: Collections
empty_description: Create your first collection to start tracking.
error_description: Your collections are safe. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
collection_error_description: Your data is safe. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
reload_error: Could not refresh from the server. These are the collections from the last successful load.
name_placeholder: e.g. Books, Vinyl Records, Board Games
finite_label: Finite set (a fixed, known number of items)
target_label: Number of items in the set
target_hint: Optional. A whole number from 1 to {{max}} — leave it empty if you do not know it yet.
submit_error: Could not create the collection. Check your input and try again.
save_error: Could not save the collection. Check your input and try again.
field_type_locked: Cannot change the type: this collection already has items, and their stored values would not convert.
remove_field_note: Removing a field hides it from every item. The values are kept in your data and stay in a JSON backup, but they are no longer shown, and adding the field back starts it empty.
tags_none: No item carries a tag here yet.
tags_none_matching: No tag in use matches that.
tags_truncated: Showing the 50 most used tags. Find a tag to reach the rest.
tags_load_error: Could not load the tags in use. Check that the app's server is running, then try again.
tags_change_error: Could not change this tag. Your items are as they were — check that the app's server is running, then try again.
